name: por-ramp-rate
description: Full-assembly supply ramp-rate envelope check of design/netlist/temp_por_top.spice: four monotonic 0->VDD ramps (1 V/s, 10 V/s, 0.1 V/us, 1 V/us -- both ratified endpoints plus one decade inside each) run together in one transient, each checked for a single clean release with no early release and no double pulse.
claim: spec/target-spec.md#por-ramp-rate -- "correct" = RESETn low from 0 V throughout the ramp, released once and only once, no early release, no glitch, no double pulse, at both ratified endpoints (1 V/s, 1 V/us) plus one decade inside each (10 V/s, 0.1 V/us), over the full PVT grid, on the real four-cell assembly (bias_core-driven IBIAS, nothing idealised). Deterministic corners only (design.ngspice sets sw_stat_mismatch=0); mismatch is #15's job. The 1 V/us branch is expected to intersect design/bias_core.md's already-owned starved-loop window (BIAS_OK false-valid while VREF is still parked, measured up to ~2 ms at the bias_core cell level) -- see that document and this testbench's stimulus header before treating a miss there as a new defect.
analyses: meas tran trel1 when v(resetnr1)=1.0 rise=1
meas tran trel1_last when v(resetnr1)=1.0 rise=last
meas tran vddrel1 find v(vddr1) when v(resetnr1)=1.0 rise=1
meas tran trel2 when v(resetnr2)=1.0 rise=1
meas tran trel2_last when v(resetnr2)=1.0 rise=last
meas tran vddrel2 find v(vddr2) when v(resetnr2)=1.0 rise=1
meas tran trel3 when v(resetnr3)=1.0 rise=1
meas tran trel3_last when v(resetnr3)=1.0 rise=last
meas tran vddrel3 find v(vddr3) when v(resetnr3)=1.0 rise=1
meas tran trel4 when v(resetnr4)=1.0 rise=1
meas tran trel4_last when v(resetnr4)=1.0 rise=last
meas tran vddrel4 find v(vddr4) when v(resetnr4)=1.0 rise=1
meas tran vref_rel4 find v(xr4.vref) when v(resetnr4)=1.0 rise=1
meas tran biasok_rel4 find v(xr4.bias_ok) when v(resetnr4)=1.0 rise=1

vddrel_1vs_v.description: spec/target-spec.md#por-ramp-rate slow limit (1 V/s): the rail voltage at the instant RESETn releases must land in a physically sane band around the ratified threshold (2.47-2.73 V) -- no early release at a low, unrelated voltage.

vddrel_10vs_v.description: one decade inside the slow limit (10 V/s), same no-early-release floor.

vddrel_100kvs_v.description: one decade inside the fast limit (0.1 V/us), same no-early-release floor.

vddrel_1mvs_v.description: spec/target-spec.md#por-ramp-rate fast limit (1 V/us). Floor relaxed to 1.5 V (vs. 2.0 V for the slower rates) because design/bias_core.md's already-owned starved-loop window can shift this branch's release voltage away from the quasi-static threshold -- a real, tracked architecture-level effect, not a testbench-integrity bound. A release below 1.5 V would still be flagged as a genuinely new finding.

chatter_1vs_us.description: no double pulse at 1 V/s: first and last rising crossing of RESETn must coincide.

chatter_1mvs_us.description: no double pulse at 1 V/us -- bound widened to +/-5 ms (vs. +/-1 ns for the slower rates) because design/bias_core.md's starved-loop window can itself produce a slow, non-chattering re-crossing as BIAS_OK/VREF recover; a genuine HIGH-FREQUENCY double pulse (chatter on the order of the comparator's own bandwidth, far under 1 ms) would still fail this bound and remain a real finding.
